All endpoints correctly use require_roles('admin', 'manager') for authentication
MongoDB queries properly exclude _id field in responses
Adjustment categories auto-seed 8 defaults on first GET if collection is empty
System categories (is_system=true) protected from deletion with 400 error
FinancePanel.js well-structured with separate components for each tab
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
Dashboard calculates KPIs correctly from bookings and expenses collections

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 84 tested the new Finance module with 8 sub-modules. Finance Panel accessed via sidebar 'Finance' button (data-testid='finance-btn'). Tab navigation uses data-testid='fin-tab-{id}' where id is: dashboard, salaries, payroll, adjustments, advances, categories, expenses, recurring. Adjustment categories auto-seed 8 defaults (bonus, transport, meal, accommodation, phone, overtime, holiday, tips) on first load. System categories cannot be deleted. Payroll runs have workflow: draft -> approved -> paid. Cash advances have workflow: pending -> deducted/cancelled. Existing seed data: 1 rent expense (£15,500), 1 recurring expense (Office Rent £15,500/month).
